name: browns-ct-pack-post-checklist
description: Offline CLI tool to generate pre-WhatsApp post checklist from browns-ct-pack-assemble output folder

scripts.test:fixtures: npm run build && npm run test:fixture:healthy && npm run test:fixture:missing-approval
scripts.test:fixture:healthy: node dist/index.js --pack fixtures/healthy-pack --outdir test-out/healthy && echo '✓ Healthy pack test passed'
scripts.test:fixture:missing-approval: node dist/index.js --pack fixtures/missing-approval-pack --outdir test-out/missing-approval 2>&1 | grep -q 'APPROVAL.md not found' && echo '✓ Missing APPROVAL test passed' || (echo '✗ Missing APPROVAL test failed' && exit 1)
